values.note: 9 single sites and 1 double (site 9). recreation.gov permits trailers only at sites 3 and 9 (24 ft) and 10 (16 ft); the other seven list tents, cars and pickup campers only, and no site lists RVs.

sites.source: recreation.gov description ('This campground offers 9 single campsites and 1 double campsite') + campsite search (permitted_equipment: site 3 Trailer 24 / Max Vehicle Length 24, site 9 Trailer 24, site 10 Trailer 16; sites 1, 2, 4-8 Tent/Pickup Camper/Vehicle/Car only; no 'RV' entry on any site), read 2026-10-30

facilities.source: FS page ('Drinking water is no longer available at Andrews Cove Campground. The campground well system is being decommissioned') + recreation.gov notice ('Drinking water will not be available at this campground'); description lists only 'a toilet faciilty adjacent to site #3' (type not given) and no dump station, read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservation only, online or 1-877-444-6777. 14 nights in any 30, then off the national forest. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 12:01 pm. Unstaffed.

booking.source: recreation.gov notices ('All Camping at Andrew's Cove is by Reservation Only. There are NO First Come, First Serve sites.'; 'Check-out time is 12:01 pm. Check-in time is 2:00 pm.') + facility_rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days' + description ('This location is unstaffed'), read 2026-10-30

note: Chattahoochee NF campground on Andrews Creek off GA-75, about 6 miles north of Helen; the entrance is on a sharp curve. Bring all water: the Forest Service is decommissioning the well. The 1.9-mile Andrews Cove Trail to the Appalachian Trail starts beside sites 6 and 7. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov confirm $12 (double $18, $8 reservation fee; fees manual, checked 2027), Senior/Access 50%, season 03-15 to 12-15 (set), no hookups/no water, 10 sites (max_rig 24 set), reservation only (fcfs never), 14 in 30; booking platform/url added. Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: CRITERIA (23-ft fit): recreation.gov permitted equipment lists no 'RV' at any site and allows trailers only at sites 3 and 9 (24 ft; site 3's driveway is listed at 14 ft) and site 10 (16 ft); sites 1, 2 and 4-8 take tents, cars and pickup campers only. inclusion_evidence's '24-78 ft stated lengths' are driveway lengths, not equipment limits. At most two sites (3, the double 9) admit a 23-ft rig, at a 24-ft limit. Human decision.
Pin OK (~80 m from the site centroid 34.7786,-83.7364). All 10 sites tagged 'Proximity to Water: Springs'.
